0260-P1 — Printed operator decomposition does not recover the stated output-shift geometry — Counterevidence: Input-sensitivity reading is legitimate but different. Released code applies SVD to sample shifts, often recovering correct output directions; no released-code right/left bug is alleged. Actual feature directions and broad multidimensional observation may survive.

0260-P2 — Signed projection statistic does not establish late-layer likelihood or certainty growth — Counterevidence: It can measure label-aligned separation. Actual model uncertainty may decrease; no measured entropy trajectory or exact historical-run version is claimed.

0260-P3 — The stated N80 partition includes the underlying test goals in raw training data — Counterevidence: Held-out jailbreak strings and new formulations can remain valid; not extended to all N, every DPO ordering, exact transformed-string overlap, or false relative rankings.

0260-P4 — The reported non-dominant-only contrast includes early dominant C1 directions — Counterevidence: Low harmfulness correlation may motivate a semantic indirect-feature definition, but it differs from SVD dominance. No claim early C1 actually caused the effects or that secondary features lack causal influence. The separate L14C6 result survives this specific criticism.

0260-P5 — Table4 final-column denominator differs from its label — Counterevidence: Correct base ratios are even smaller. Coordinate-averaging MSE convention is unavailable; no established factor4096 error or invalidated small-error conclusion.

proposition.claim:
Right singular vectors of W-I describe representation-shift directions; squared singular-value fractions describe shift variance.

Rising prediction log-likelihood with plateaued accuracy demonstrates reduced uncertainty in later layers.

The60 STRONG REJECT test samples are completely disjoint from training, supporting unseen-query generalization.

Suppress non-dominant components while leaving dominant components untouched to establish causal effects of indirect features.

Last column is MSE divided by mean squared unaligned activation norm.

assumptions: Finite equal-weight input distributions; exact affine T(x)=Wx+b; unique affine fit in the first two witnesses. No unasserted nonlinear-fit error or input isotropy. The anisotropic witness uses all four independent-sign combinations.

Use exact retained statistic mean((z-mean(z))*(2y-1)), balanced binary labels, same prevalence threshold. Explicit logistic link used only to provide an admissible counterexample to the statistic-to-certainty implication.
Manuscript N80 mixture includes all313 raw STRONG REJECT goals; the60 test goals are drawn from that same corpus. Distinguish goal identity from wrapped-string identity.
C1 is dominant at every layer by paper definition; AppendixD states all4096 directions beforelayer10 are suppressed.
Use six rows exactly as printed; account for displayed rounding.
